pages.title: Gensokyo Flora
pages.text: Brewing runs on the mod's own plants: ghost fire, dream and demonic miasma mushroom caps from their huge mushroom trees, plus wild star flowers and flame cattails. Keep a mixed stock, since almost every brew combines two or more of them.
Alongside the modded plants, the pot also accepts some vanilla goods: powders, monster drops and similar staples. Check JEI under Alchemy Pot for the exact list of each recipe.
